newsitem.title: LATVIA: OLAINFARM, KAIJA INJECT SOME LIFE INTO BOURSE.
newsitem.headline: OLAINFARM, KAIJA INJECT SOME LIFE INTO BOURSE.

text.p: * Share trade slightly more active at close at 66,000 lats versus 46,000 lats.
* Olainfarm most active at 12,500 lats, adds 10 santimes to 2.50 lats
* Kaija jumps into life, trades 11,200 lats, adds two to 2.13
The bourse picked up slightly in trade on Wednesday, with activity in drugs maker Olainfarm and fish cannery Kaija giving some impetus to the market.
The bourse's new official index, formally launched today after two months of delay, added one percent to 379.98. The index is calculated from 100 on April 2 1996.
Turnover was 66,000 lats versus yesterday's 46,000 lats and Olainfarm traded 12,500 lats to rise to 2.50 from 2.40 lats, the highest it has been since joining the bourse last week.

Dealers said investors may have taken heart from company statements that a surprise first quarter loss was due to one-off tax items. Since entering the bourse, the share has been turbulent, falling as low as 2.09 lats.
Kaija was second most active share at 11,200 lats, adding two santimes to 2.13 lats.
Dealers did not really know why the stock rose but noted that gains may go no further as supply today of 41,000 shares easily outstripped demand of 8,800 shares.
Riga Jewellery was traded for the first time since joining the bourse on Monday, falling near the maximum 15 percent to 58 santimes from 68 santimes on 1,100 lats trade.

Staburadze on the official list was again active at 9,500 lats to fall to 2.69 lats from 2.70 lats while Strenci Forestry was uncharacteristically busy on the secondary list at 9,800 lats for a rise of 14 santimes to 1.64 lats.
